# BICF Core Implementation

## Overview
Axiomatic foundation for Boundary-Interior Combinatorial Framework with formal compliance testing.

## Features
- Boundary/Interior duality with explicit realization
- Validity predicates and transformation interfaces
- Non-canonicity enforcement
- Deterministic constraint satisfaction
- Comprehensive compliance testing suite

## Implementation
Complete R5RS Scheme implementation of all BICF axioms with:
- Soundness verification
- Non-canonicity testing
- Transform preservation
- Projection safety
- Explicitness enforcement

## Usage
```scheme
(load "bicf-core.scm")
(test-bicf-compliance tetrahedron-boundary)
```

## Status
✅ Complete - All axioms implemented and tested
